scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because the headline absolute values are strongly method-dependent (functional, pseudopotentials, plane-wave cutoff) and the paper's quantitative values are not expected to be reproduced exactly. T2 consistency would require partial recompute from richer raw artifacts (e.g., strain-energy curves), which are not declared as scored outputs. Therefore T3 structural: verify required monotonic trends, chirality ordering, and convergence to the sheet limit.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed diameter, binding energy per ZnO unit, Young's modulus, average Zn-O bond length, and Bader charge transfer for armchair (n,n) and zigzag (n,0) SWZONTs (n=3..10) and the ZnO graphitic sheet.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies that the computed properties exhibit the expected physical trends (monotonic changes with diameter, chirality differences, and convergence to the graphitic sheet limit) without disclosing the specific direction of each trend.

steps.description: CSV contains rows for armchair n=3..10, zigzag n=3..10, and sheet row.
Binding energy strictly decreases with n for both chiralities.
For each n, armchair binding energy lower than zigzag.
Young's modulus strictly increases with n for both chiralities.
Average bond length strictly decreases with n.
Charge transfer strictly increases with n.
Binding energy difference to sheet decreases monotonically with n.
Young's modulus difference to sheet decreases monotonically with n.
Bond length difference to sheet decreases monotonically with n.
Charge transfer difference to sheet decreases monotonically with n.
